name: Authenticated Home — Timeline Events Feed
description: After login, the home page shows a chronological timeline of upcoming and past events the user is invited to or attending, grouped by date, with status badges (Invited), attendee avatar stacks, host names, location, and time.
evidence_quote: Events | Upcoming | Past | May 27 Wednesday | Builders & Brews Berlin | By Tavily Events, Waqas Makhdum, n8n, Marcel Claus-Ahrens & 1 other | St. Oberholz | Invited | +234

name: Event Creation Form — Core Fields
description: The event creation form at /create exposes: Event Name, Start/End datetime (timezone auto-set from IP), Add Event Location (offline or virtual link), Add Description, and a Calendar selector.
evidence_quote: Event Name | Start | End | GMT+02:00 Berlin | Add Event Location | Offline location or virtual link | Add Description

name: Event Visibility — Public vs Private Toggle
description: During event creation, a dropdown toggles the event between Public ('Shown on your calendar and eligible to be featured') and Private ('Unlisted. Only people with the link can register').
evidence_quote: Public — Shown on your calendar and eligible to be featured. | Private — Unlisted. Only people with the link can register.

name: Event Options — Require Approval Toggle
description: An Event Options toggle labeled 'Require Approval' controls whether registrations are auto-approved or held for host review before the guest is confirmed.
evidence_quote: Event Options | Ticket Price Free | Payment Optional | Require Approval | Capacity Unlimited | Waitlist Enabled

name: Event Options — Capacity Limit with Waitlist
description: Hosts can set a numeric capacity cap for an event (default Unlimited); enabling a cap also surfaces a 'Waitlist Enabled' option so overflow registrants are queued automatically.
evidence_quote: Capacity | Unlimited | Waitlist Enabled

name: Event Options — Ticket Pricing via Stripe
description: The Ticket Price option (default Free, with a 'Payment Optional' sub-option) triggers a Stripe connection flow; the host must connect or create a Stripe account before accepting paid registrations. Credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and regional methods (iDEAL, Konbini, PayNow) are supported.
evidence_quote: Accept Payments — Your account is not yet set up to accept payments. We use Stripe to process payments. Connect or set up a Stripe account to start accepting payments. It usually takes less than 5 minutes.

name: Event Theme Picker
description: A theme picker panel on the event creation form offers preset themes (Minimal, Quantum, Warp, Emoji, Confetti, Pattern, Seasonal) plus controls for Color (custom), Style, Font (default Degular), and Display mode.
evidence_quote: Minimal | Quantum | Warp | Emoji | Confetti | Pattern | Seasonal | Color | Custom | Style | — | Font | Degular | Display | Auto

name: Event Creation — Calendar Assignment
description: When creating an event the host selects which calendar it belongs to via a dropdown; events placed under a calendar grant that calendar's admins manage access. A 'Create Calendar' option is inline.
evidence_quote: Choose the calendar of the event: Personal Calendar ✓ | + Create Calendar | Creating the event under a calendar grants its admins manage access.

name: Calendars — My Calendars + Subscribed Calendars
description: The Calendars section is split into 'My Calendars' (calendars the user administrates, with a '+ Create' button) and 'Subscribed Calendars' (calendars the user follows, each showing upcoming events and a 'View Calendar' button).
evidence_quote: My Calendars | Create | No Calendars — You are not an admin of any calendars. | Subscribed Calendars | AI Builders | View Calendar | Upcoming Events | AI Builders Berlin Tue, May 19, 5:30 PM

name: Calendar Onboarding — 'Every event on Luma is part of a calendar'
description: A first-time onboarding modal in the Calendars section explains that every Luma event belongs to a calendar, establishing calendar-first architecture as the platform's organizational model.
evidence_quote: Welcome to Luma Calendar — Luma Calendar lets you easily share and manage your events. Every event on Luma is part of a calendar. Let's see how they work.

name: Calendar Public Page — Subscribe Button + Submit Event
description: Each public calendar page has a 'Subscribe'/'Subscribed' toggle button and a 'Submit Event' button that lets community members propose events for the calendar; submitted events await approval from the calendar admin before appearing on the schedule.
evidence_quote: Subscribed | AI Builders | Submit Event | You have 0 events pending approval by the calendar admin. They will show up on the schedule once approved.

name: Discover — Geo-personalised Popular Events + Category Browse
description: The /discover page auto-detects the user's city (Berlin in this session) and shows geo-personalised popular events; a 'Browse by Category' grid lists Tech, Food & Drink, AI, Arts & Culture, Climate, Fitness, Wellness, Crypto, plus a 'Featured Calendars' section and regional city filters.
evidence_quote: Discover Events — Explore popular events near you, browse by category, or check out some of the great community calendars. | Popular Events Berlin | Browse by Category | Tech 4K Events | Food & Drink 403 Events | AI 3K Events

name: Discover — Featured Calendars with Subscribe CTA
description: The Discover page surfaces a curated 'Featured Calendars' section with community calendars (FOMO, Gezellig Sessions, OpenClaw Meetups, Reading Rhythms Global, Build Club, etc.) each with a Subscribe button, enabling platform-level calendar promotion.
evidence_quote: Featured Calendars | Subscribe | FOMO | Berlin · We create extraordinary experiences for extraordinary people | Subscribe | Reading Rhythms Global | Not a book club. A reading party.

name: Discover — City/Region Event Browser
description: The Discover page includes an 'Explore Local Events' section with tabs for Europe, Asia & Pacific, Africa, North America, South America, each showing cities with live event counts (e.g., London 77, Berlin 49, Paris 34).
evidence_quote: Explore Local Events | Europe | Asia & Pacific | Africa | North America | South America | Berlin 49 Events | London 77 Events | Paris 34 Events | Amsterdam 49 Events

name: In-App Notifications — Event Invites, Message Blasts, Date Changes
description: A bell-icon notification panel in the top nav surfaces in-app notifications for: event invitations (person X invited you), host message blasts sent to registered attendees, and date-change announcements for events the user has RSVPd to.
evidence_quote: Colin Nebius invited you to Enterprise Agents Unleashed: Berlin Hackathon | 0xMihej sent a message to Algorand Builders Berlin... | New dates announced - 6-7th of June | Silicon Allee invited you to Deep Tech Night

name: Notification Preferences — Multi-channel (Email, WhatsApp, Push)
description: Settings/Preferences exposes per-notification-type channel toggles across Email, WhatsApp, and push notification, covering: Event Invites, Event Reminders, Event Blasts, Event Updates, Feedback Requests (attendee side) and Guest Registrations, Feedback Responses, New Members, Event Submissions (host/calendar-admin side).
evidence_quote: Events You Attend: Event Invites Email, WhatsApp | Event Reminders Email, WhatsApp | Event Blasts Email, WhatsApp | Event Updates Email | Events You Host: Guest Registrations Email

name: Settings — Social Links on Profile
description: User profile settings include fields for Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, and a personal website URL — all displayed on the public profile page.
evidence_quote: Social Links | instagram.com/ | x.com/ | youtube.com/@ | tiktok.com/@ | linkedin.com | Your website

name: Settings — Web3 Wallet Linking (Solana, Ethereum)
description: The Account settings page allows linking Solana and Ethereum wallet addresses alongside Google and Apple social auth, enabling token-gating use cases.
evidence_quote: Third Party Accounts — Link your accounts to sign in to Luma and automate your workflows. | Solana Not Linked | Ethereum Not Linked

name: Settings — Calendar Sync (iCal, Google, Outlook, Apple)
description: The Account settings page offers 'Calendar Syncing' with iCal subscription support (Google, Outlook, Apple) and 'Sync Contacts with Google' to import Gmail contacts for easy event invitations.
evidence_quote: Calendar Syncing — Sync your Luma events with your Google, Outlook, or Apple calendar. Add iCal Subscription | Sync Contacts with Google — Sync your Gmail contacts to easily invite them to your events.

name: Settings Payment — Saved Payment Methods (Stripe-encrypted)
description: The Payment settings tab stores the user's saved credit/debit cards for attending paid events; cards are encrypted and stored by Stripe. A Payment History section shows past event ticket purchases with amounts and card last four.
evidence_quote: Payment Methods — Your saved payment methods are encrypted and stored securely by Stripe. | Mastercard •••• 4880 Expiry: 03/2029 Default | Payment History | AI Builders Monthly Berlin €5.00

name: Luma Plus — Calendar-Level Paid Subscription
description: Luma Plus is a paid subscription that applies at the calendar level (not the user level) for $59/month (billed annually, ~$69/mo monthly). It removes the 5% platform fee, raises invite/newsletter volume to 5,000/week, adds tax collection, a check-in manager role, custom event URLs, separate first/last name collection, 5 calendar admins, Zapier automation, and API access.
evidence_quote: Luma Plus $59 per month, billed annually. 0% platform fee for paid events. Send up to 5,000 invites and newsletters per week. Ability to collect taxes for ticket sales. Custom URL for event pages. API access.

name: Free Plan — Unlimited Events, 5% Platform Fee, 500 Invites/Week
description: The free Luma plan supports unlimited events, unlimited guests per event, blasts and automated reminders via email/SMS/push/WhatsApp, up to 500 invites or newsletters per week, check-in, all payment card types, ticket types/coupons/group purchasing, up to 3 calendar admins, and token-gating — with a 5% platform fee on paid events.
evidence_quote: Use Luma for free with: Unlimited number of events | Unlimited number of guests per event | Blasts and automated reminders via email, SMS, push notification and WhatsApp | Send up to 500 invites or newsletters per week | 5% platform fee for paid events

name: Public Profile — Hosted/Attended Event Counts
description: Each user's public profile at /user/<id> shows their display name, join date, and counts for events Hosted and Attended, along with a list of past public events — social credibility signals visible without authentication.
evidence_quote: Jonatan Snyders | Joined November 2024 | 0 Hosted | 14 Attended | Nothing Here, Yet — Jonatan Snyders has no public events at this time.

name: Event Detail Side-Panel — In-Feed RSVP without Page Nav
description: Clicking an event card on the home feed opens a slide-out side panel with the event image, 'Featured in [City]' badge, hosts, date/time, location, and a full RSVP form (Accept Invite / Decline) without leaving the feed page. Also shows 'Copy Link' and 'Event Page' buttons.
evidence_quote: Copy Link | Event Page | Featured in Berlin | Builders & Brews Berlin | Registration | You are invited by Nebius Events | Welcome, Jonatan! To join the event, please register below. | Accept Invite | Decline

name: Global Search / Command Palette
description: A keyboard-accessible command palette (search icon in top nav) lets users search for events, calendars, and more; it shows contextual shortcuts (Create Event, Open Home, Open Calendars, Open Discover, Open Help) and a live 'Attending' section listing upcoming RSVPd events.
evidence_quote: Search for events, calendars and more... | Shortcuts: Create Event | Open Home | Open Calendars | Open Discover | Open Help | Attending | Enterprise Agents Unleashed: Berlin Hackathon May 29, 10:00 AM
